title: Safe-zone guide on the vertical launch film
caption: mgvideo safezone --platform reels burns the Reels safe area, the strictest of the Reels, Shorts and TikTok presets, onto the native 9:16 launch film (f07) for review: shaded top and bottom margins where the app UI sits, white labels on dark backings, and the dashed area the cards must stay inside.
